$comment: Generated from intlify/vue-i18n @ 12.0.0-alpha.4 by calling fallbackWithSimple() and fallbackWithLocaleChain() with a fresh context for every (start, fallback) pair. The TypeScript result is the source of truth; both ports are held to it. Regenerate only when upstream changes, and say so in the commit. Each fallback is recorded as the JSON text it was written as, never re-serialised from the parsed JavaScript object: that would rewrite a map's keys into Object.keys order and drop an own '__proto__' key, and the corpus could then no longer tell a port that gets those right from one that does not.
